📊 What moved today, Tuesday 24 November

🇿🇦 A quieter day on the JSE after Monday's bounce. The Top 40 slipped 0.3% to 98,373. Resource shares fell 1.2% as gold slipped 1.1% to about $3,591, while banks and insurers edged up 0.4%.

💱 The rand weakened to about R17.51 to the dollar, and Brent oil rose 1.6% to about $90.76.

What it means for you: a weaker rand and dearer oil today chip away at the expected December petrol cut.

🎬 Tonight at 18:30: how the rand reaches your pocket, in under a minute.
